source_title_en: Industrial prestressed beams (buildings and bridge decks)
units: base cm in source (stored mm); portées limites m; poids kg/ml
scaling_method: Embedded raster (240x143 px, PDF p2) thresholded at grey<200; per-row outline extents measured for each beam. Scale = printed base / pixel base: 11.11, 10.98, 11.11, 11.00 mm/px for I40/I45/I50/I55. Measured web widths 111/165/211/253 mm vs callouts 100/150/200/250 (one ~11 mm stroke). Row counts (incl. strokes): top flange 19-20, top taper 8-9, bottom taper 9, bottom flange 13-14, total 111 px = 1218-1233 mm.

estimated_dimensions.top_width_rule: equal to base width (outline drawn symmetric top/bottom)

geometry_notes: PROVENANCE estimate for all four sizes: only base width (table) and web width (graphic callouts 10/15/20/25 cm) are printed.
Depth, flange and taper heights scaled from the raster graphic to +/-11 mm (1 px); the four outlines are drawn at a common scale and common depth.
Sharp corners: the graphic resolution cannot show chamfers or fillets.
Mass check at an assumed 2500 kg/m3 (density not stated; brochure masses may include reinforcement): I45 -9.6 %, I50 -4.0 %, I55 -3.7 % mass deficit vs mass-implied area. Not fitted.
I40 printed mass 282 kg/m implies 0.113 m2, inconsistent with its outline (~0.26 m2) and the family progression; preserved verbatim as a source anomaly.
Web callouts in the graphic are small blobs; 10/15/20/25 cm reading is consistent with the scaled widths.
